summary: Cloudflare tunnels, Access apps and DNS through Cloudflare's official MCP server, on demand (zero idle context).

help:
Usage: st cloudflare <login|finish|status|tunnels|access-apps|access-policies|zones|dns|api|tools|call> --help
One-time OAuth grant stored as the Aico login cloudflare-mcp-oauth. Reads: tunnels, access-apps, access-policies, zones, dns. Any other call: api METHOD PATH [--json BODY] or call TOOL --json ARGS.
help.login:
Usage: st cloudflare login [--account ID] [--scopes "A B"]
Prints one approval URL, waits for the browser callback on 127.0.0.1, saves the grant as an Aico login. Not needed again.
help.finish:
Usage: st cloudflare finish <callback-url>
Completes a login when the browser could not reach the callback listener.
help.status:
Usage: st cloudflare status
Who the grant is, its scopes and expiry. No secrets.
help.tunnels:
Usage: st cloudflare tunnels [--account ID] [--raw]
Read-only tunnel list.
help.access-apps:
Usage: st cloudflare access-apps [--account ID] [--raw]
Read-only Access apps with their policies.
help.dns:
Usage: st cloudflare dns [--zone summitflow.dev] [--type A] [--name host] [--raw]
Read-only DNS records.
help.api:
Usage: st cloudflare api METHOD PATH [--json BODY] [--account ID]
Any Cloudflare API call through the server's execute tool; limited to the granted scopes.

usage.when: inspect or change Cloudflare tunnels, Access apps/policies and DNS without the dashboard or the owner's Chrome
precautions: Reads are safe; api/call with POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE changes live Cloudflare state.
Needs the one-time owner approval (st cloudflare login); never print the cloudflare-mcp-oauth login.
